title: Useful Diorite, Granite, and Andesite
description: Tired of useless blocks filling your inventory? Then this mod is for you!
body:
Tired of your inventory filling up with useless blocks while out on long mining trips? Worry no more, for this mod makes those useless blocks just as useful as Cobblestone.

Diorite, Granite, and Andesite can be used to make utilities such as Furnaces, Pickaxes, Pistons, Stonecutters, just about anything that only Cobblestone could do previously. Calcite, Smooth Basalt, and Tuff can also be used.

See Gallery for recipe examples.
